Find records across the permitted kinds in the bound scope, or the Rules bound to a source file and symbol.

Usage: provenance [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Arguments:
  <COMMAND>  [possible values: search]

Options:
      --repo <REPO>       [default: .]
      --scope <SCOPE>     [default: default]
      --format <FORMAT>   [possible values: json]
      --quiet             
      --text <TEXT>       Text to find in record ids and text.
      --cursor <CURSOR>   The continuation from an earlier page of the same search.
      --kind <KIND>       Record kinds to return.
      --limit <LIMIT>     The page size. The default is 50.
      --include-terminal  Include archived and other terminal records.
      --file <FILE>       Return the Rules bound in this repository-relative source file.
      --symbol <SYMBOL>   Put the Rules bound to this symbol first. Needs file.
      --line <LINE>       Put the Rules bound at this line first. Needs file.
  -h, --help              Print help
